text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Hello, Sis?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "—So you see, in the end, you should just do what you want to do! Dad and the others are supporting Tsu-chan running in the Kikuka Sho too..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "Geez! Do you really understand!?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know—!
...Ah, training is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
For always cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: All riiight, let's do our best today too--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Just because I'm aiming for the Kikuka Sho again
doesn't mean anything's dramatically changed.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (After all, my body is just my body. ...Still,)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...Now then, after a short break, I'll pass the baton right back to you, Trainer~."
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, shall we run one more lap?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
Please!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(This is still my body,
but it's no longer the same as it was before!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(The day I wasted the feelings entrusted to me.
The day I almost lost my next chance.
Because the me who overcame all that is "absolute".)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Because I have a past behind me to look back on
—I have the "potential" to move forward!)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Things are going so smoothly, it's like before summer never even happened.
I can breathe a sigh of relief for now...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"...To say for certain, Trainer-san
doesn't seem quite satisfied yet, does he~?"
choice_data_list: Our goal is to win, of course!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...! Ho ho ho, indeed it is~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to her physical condition,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi had avoided participating in mock races until now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because of that, she has little experience
being pressured by other Umamusume. However, maintaining
one's own pace is the key to winning the Kikuka Sho."
choice_data_list: Whether we can support you from here on out is the key, I think.
Whether we can support you from here on out is the key, I think.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just like always, I'll do everything I can. I'll use my connections, anything I have—!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*!
Working hard, Tsuru-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Teio-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Tsurumaru-san.
I am Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen.
The strongest stayer the Mejiro family boasts.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-chan too?!
Why are the two of you here...!
choice_data_list: I asked both of them for help too.
I asked the two of them for help as well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Honestly. You'd better be grateful
that a busy person like me is helping you out~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You say that now,
even though you were so restless waiting
to see when a request for help would come.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wawa, McQueen!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"On a separate note, I also heard from Bright
that Tsurumaru-san provided her with support."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wish to repay that debt. I have come to share the Mejiro family's wisdom with all of you trainers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Physician
text_block_list.text:
I am the Mejiro family's personal physician.
Here is my business card.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Waaah...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's keep doing our best until the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ~~gh, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's do a practice race right away!
Your opponents will be me, Tokai Teio, and...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: With Biwa Hayahide, who has some history with Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's me, Nice Nature, who ran in the
Kikuka Sho during Teio's year.
...Uh, you sure I'm not out of place here?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's not just Teio-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course!
Trainer told me to put plenty of pressure
on Tsuru-chan, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Brace yourself, Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Go win the Kikuka-sho for me, since I couldn't run it due to my injury!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! Teio-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since your whole future is ahead of you, I bet you can do it.
Now then—heeeere we go~!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I see...
There are so many conditions that can be prevented
just by properly addressing the horseshoes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Physician
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, if any abnormality in gait is
observed, diagnostic anesthesia is recommended
in addition to palpation. Regarding this—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Your class time
seems to be quite productive as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, until the Kikuka Sho, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi trained to win, while we studied how best to support her to victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Steadily, one day at a time.
Walking forward step by step, making sure of each—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Kikuka Sho had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The me whose health suddenly took a turn for the worse
is still a part of my past, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —However.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, Sensei!! I look forward to continuing to work with you!!"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Tsurumaru-san...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of your support,
I am standing here at the Kikuka Sho today.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Even when things felt hopeless,
and even when I was on the verge of giving up, you all were there for me.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I am standing right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And so! Allow me to declare it once again!
Tsuyoshi wants to be just like the President!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Crowns and titles might change!
Because I have the 'potential' to become whatever I want!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Into an extraordinarily "strong" Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...They've left for the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
I want to apologize to you once more.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Back in the summer, I said her stamina could only hold out for 1800m.
I even said that running the Kikuka Sho itself would be impossible."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now...
I can't help but hope for a miracle
...one that will overturn that impossibility."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A miracle.
Why do such things happen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even the training before this Kikuka Sho
was essentially a miracle in itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We managed to arrange a training match alongside Tokai Teio and the others.
We even secured cooperation from the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “However, she was able to do so—because Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi had formed a bond that was anything but shallow with them.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was on good terms with Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To genuinely support Mejiro Bright as a member of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If binding the past—the certainty—is what allows the future—the possibility—to exist...
choice_data_list: This miracle happened because Trainer was here too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because he partnered up with her,
she's safely able to continue running even today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This isn't about there just happening to be
a chance of a miracle occurring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The reason Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi is able to keep running as an Umamusume today is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—It's because there was someone who wished,
'I want Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi to succeed.'"
choice_data_list: Let's go watch her potential unfold.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The future arrives because of the layered past.
It is precisely because the past is "absolute"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A new future [possibility] is born.
